2609.37956.title: BrainNet Studio: A Unified Toolkit for Brain Network Construction, Intelligent Analysis, and Visualization
2609.37956.paper_summary: Brain networks characterize structural and functional relationships among brain regions and support research on cognition, brain disorders, and brain-computer interfaces. Their time-varying topology and higher-order spatiotemporal dependencies are not adequately represented by conventional static networks. Existing tools primarily focus on static connectomes and provide limited integration of dynamic network modeling with modern graph and sequence learning methods. We present BrainNet Studio, an integrated toolkit for static and dynamic brain network analysis. It provides a unified workflow encompassing network construction, feature extraction, predictive modeling, candidate biomarker identification, visualization, and assisted interpretation. The toolkit integrates 27 algorithms, including deep learning, graph neural networks, and spatiotemporal sequence models, to support classification and the identification of discriminative brain regions and connections. A large language model generates researcher-verifiable summaries of functional connectivity, structural connectivity, and structure-function coupling at individual and group levels. Within a consistent computational framework, users can configure analytical tasks, compare methods, inspect outputs, and extend functionality without repeatedly assembling application-specific pipelines. BrainNet Studio provides a practical and extensible platform for connectome analysis in cognitive neuroscience, exploratory studies of brain disorders, and brain-computer interfaces. The toolkit is publicly available at https://github.com/xbrainnet/Brainnet-Studio.
2609.37956.paper_summary_zh: 腦網絡特徵化腦區之間的結構和功能關係，並支持對認知、腦障礙和腦-計算機接口的研究。它們的時間變化拓撲和高階時空依賴性並未被傳統靜態網絡充分表達。現有工具主要專注於靜態連接組，並對動態網絡建模與現代圖形和序列學習方法的整合提供有限支持。我們介紹了BrainNet Studio，一個靜態和動態腦網絡分析的綜合工具包。它提供了一個統一的工作流程，涵蓋網絡構建、特徵提取、預測建模、候選生物標記識別、可視化和輔助解釋。該工具包整合了27種算法，包括深度學習、圖神經網絡和時空序列模型，以支持分類和識別具有區分性的腦區和連接。一個大型語言模型生成可供研究者驗證的功能連接、結構連接和結構-功能耦合的摘要，涵蓋個體和群體層面。在一致的計算框架內，用戶可以配置分析任務、比較方法、檢查輸出並擴展功能，而無需重複組裝特定應用的管道。BrainNet Studio為認知神經科學中的連接組分析、腦障礙的探索性研究及腦-計算機接口提供了一個實用且可擴展的平台。該工具包可在 https://github.com/xbrainnet/Brainnet-Studio 取得。
